evidence.source_text: SYNTHETIC SOFTWARE TEST PROTOCOL WF-001. Not a clinical treatment protocol. Title: Schedule workflow test. Phase 1. Indication: software validation. This protocol has one Schedule of Assessments, divided across two tables for readability. Both tables apply to all the same enrolled participants; there are no separately assigned substudies, cohorts or treatment arms. Day 1 is the date of first dose (FIRST_DOSE). Clinical days have no Day 0. The site records the actual LAST_DOSE date separately.
